mechanism: Verapamil inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes deutetrabenazine and its active metabolites, increasing their plasma concentrations and risk of adverse effects including QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor cardiac function (ECG, QTc interval) closely and consider dose reduction of deutetrabenazine; alternative antiarrhythmic or antihypertensive agents with less CYP3A4 interaction may be preferred.
